content.value_statement: Background jobs often fail when timers, retries, and side effects are handled inside normal request code. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code clear Inngest patterns for durable workflows.
actual_capabilities: Explains durable Inngest function structure using createFunction and step handlers.
Shows how to replace server timers with step.sleep and step.sleepUntil patterns.
Covers step.run boundaries for side effects, retries, and memoized step IDs.
Describes waitForEvent, parallel steps, loops, rate limits, throttles, debounce, and priority.
Documents failure handlers, rollback steps, and NonRetriableError usage.
Names the required central registration file for Inngest functions.
limitations: It provides documentation patterns only and does not execute Inngest commands.
It assumes a TypeScript project that already uses Inngest.
It does not validate deployed functions or inspect runtime logs.
It does not cover every Inngest API or provider integration.

use_cases.title: Create Order Workflows
use_cases.description: Design payment waits, cancellation paths, and rollback handling for order processing jobs.

use_cases.title: Standardize Job Reliability
use_cases.description: Apply consistent step boundaries, retries, throttles, and registration rules across background functions.

use_cases.title: Build Event-Driven Features
use_cases.description: Plan delayed emails, approval waits, search indexing, and priority processing with Inngest patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Simple Function
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner task for a new Inngest workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the inngest-handler skill to create a basic Inngest function for this event: [event name]. Include safe step names and retry behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor a Background Task
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate task for moving fragile async work into Inngest.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the inngest-handler skill to refactor this background task into an Inngest workflow. Replace timers with durable sleeps and wrap side effects in steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Multi-Step Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for a workflow with waits and external services.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the inngest-handler skill to design a multi-step workflow for [business process]. Include waitForEvent, rate limits, failure handling, and registration guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Audit an Existing Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of reliability and correctness risks.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the inngest-handler skill to audit this Inngest function. Identify unsafe timers, side effects outside steps, unstable step IDs, retry issues, and missing registration.

output_examples.input: A request to create an order-processing job with payment delay and cancellation.
output_examples.output: A workflow plan with validation, durable payment wait, payment event matching, cancellation handling, and function registration guidance.

output_examples.input: A request to review a job that writes to the database outside a step.
output_examples.output: A review explaining why the write must move into a named step, with notes on memoization and retry behavior.

output_examples.input: A request to process many customer sync tasks without overloading an API.
output_examples.output: A design using parallel steps, stable loop step IDs, rate limiting, throttling, and retry configuration.

best_practices: Put every side effect inside step.run with a stable and descriptive step ID.
Use step.sleep, sleepUntil, and waitForEvent instead of server timers.
Register every function in the central Inngest functions index.
anti_patterns: Using setTimeout or setInterval inside a serverless workflow.
Creating random step IDs or unstable IDs outside controlled loops.
Saving needed step output in outer mutable variables instead of returning it.

faq.question: What is this skill for?
faq.answer: It helps AI agents design Inngest functions for durable background jobs, workflows, retries, delays, and event waits.

faq.question: Does this skill run Inngest commands?
faq.answer: No. It is documentation guidance and does not execute commands, install packages, or deploy functions.

faq.question: Can it help migrate cron jobs?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide the structure for scheduled or delayed work when the project already uses Inngest.

faq.question: Does it understand my database schema?
faq.answer: No. You must provide project-specific models, events, and business rules when asking for implementation help.

faq.question: How should I use it with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: Ask for a specific Inngest function, workflow review, or refactor and include the relevant event names and constraints.

faq.question: Can it guarantee production reliability?
faq.answer: No. It provides implementation patterns, but teams must test workflows, monitor runs, and validate failure behavior.
